title: Package Management
task: From captures/debian-packages.tsv, write the installed version of runner-tools in version.txt. From captures/fedora-owners.tsv, write the owner of /usr/bin/runner in owner.txt. Write one value per report.
hints: Read both captures and look at their first row.
Filter by an exact first field in each file and print field 2.
Use runner-tools in the Debian inventory and /usr/bin/runner in the Fedora capture.

checks.label: The Debian installed version matches the package
checks.feedback: Match runner-tools exactly. Include the distribution revision.

checks.label: The Fedora package owns the precise executable path
checks.feedback: Search by the full /usr/bin/runner path and print its package.

demo.explanation: This is the installed version in the sample inventory, including the distribution revision.
The exact path identifies its owner independently of the command's name.
